notes.content:

notes.content:

The sale will go live today at 10am PT / 6pm BST.

That's 20% off for a VR and non-VR first-person cyber puzzler with over 40 haunting locations to explore. Not only that, but this is also the best version of the game with a complete overhaul from start to finish. If you haven't seen all of the wonderful changes we made for the Reboot, check out our announcements here https://steamcommunity.com/app/1206620/allnews

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c4f5VtTBZIg&feature=emb_title

- Fixed a rotation issue with the cutscene on the boat when using VR
- Fixed not being able to rebind switching powers
- Fixed Horizontal/Vertical Sensitivity synchronisation when using a mouse
- Fixed save data issue in Jungle when restarting after completion
- Fixed an issue with the boat in the beach

- Improved 21:9 Support

Linux Beta:
You can play a Linux version of the game on our beta branch if you're on Linux!
Bug Fixes:
- Artbook now viewable
- Videos Player fixed
- Rendering issue with screen-space reflections fixed (off by default)

notes.title: UPDATE: Full VR Support on Launch!
notes.content:
After announcing the new enhanced version of Soul Axiom, we are proud to reveal that Soul Axiom Rebooted will receive full VR support on Steam for HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, Valve Index and Windows Mixed Reality on February 27th.

With over 40 beautiful yet haunting locations, VR support was one of the top requested features from our community since the birth of Soul Axiom on Steam Early Access. Now with a complete engine upgrade, we can finally offer the experience everyone has been waiting for!

[h2]HOW TO PLAY[/h2]
Soul Axiom Rebooted is designed to be played with or without a VR device. Only one purchase is necessary, you will be given the option to play in VR or Non-VR when starting the game. You are free to switch between modes and carry on where you left off.
 
[h2]VR LOCOMOTION[/h2]
- Teleportation (coming soon)
- Smooth Artificial Locomotion
           - Thumbstick Navigation
           - Head Tracked Navigation
           - Hand Tracked Navigation (Onward)
 
[h2]GAMEPLAY AREA[/h2]
- Seated
- Standing
- Room-Scale
 
[h2]SUPPORTED CONTROLS[/h2]
- Standard controller
- Oculus Touch
- Steam Index Knuckles
- Vive Controller
- Windows Mixed Reality controller
- Keyboard & mouse
 
[h2]ADDITIONAL VR FEATURES[/h2]
- Smooth rotation with adjustable speeds
- Snap rotation with adjustable degrees
- Motion Tunnel Vision to limit FOV when in motion
- Adjustable UI distance
- Full game playable in VR

See the full list of new features here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1206620/announcements/detail/1718622067703866802

Don't forget to Wishlist the game to follow the launch on February 27th

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206620/Soul_Axiom_Rebooted/

notes.title: Soul Axiom Rebooted: What's New?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715316/2ceccb71fbacbb62e70ea01c74bb8b0fa25c31f1.gif[/img]

Want to know what went into the new enhanced version of Soul Axiom? See our patch notes below!

[h2]Upgraded Engine[/h2]
Our initial plans to upgrade Soul Axiom started out small but as time went on we realised to get all the updates we wanted out of it we needed to completely upgrade the Unity engine by a significant amount of iterations. This meant we pretty much had to rebuild the game, from scratch. 

[h2]Full VR Support[/h2]
One of the most exciting features we are proud to announce is full VR support for HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, Valve Index and Windows Mixed Reality. The entire game is playable in VR and the VR version is coupled with the non-VR version, so you can switch between the two if you wish. To find out all the VR detailed, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1206620/announcements/detail/3241965989312609573]see our thread here[/url]. 

[h2]Added localization support[/h2]
We have overhauled the underneath of the game to include support for additional languages including [b]French[/b], [b]German[/b], [b]Russian[/b], [b]Simplified Chinese[/b],[b]Ukrainian[/b] and [b]Turkish[/b]. We will consider adding more languages if there is enough request…so let us know if there’s a language you’d like to see supported in the game!

[h2]New Objective System[/h2]
Feeling lost? Trapped in a memory? Utilise the new objective system to reveal your current goal. You are just one click away from... realising that inconspicuous box right next to you is the key to all your problems.

[h2]Added Checkpoints to the memory levels[/h2]
Soul Axiom is a big game with some large levels. Can’t figure out the end of a puzzle but don’t want to lose your progress? The 'Ax now features a healthy number of mid-level checkpoints to pick up where you left off the next time you visit that memory.

[h2]Improved narrative[/h2]
The mystery of your digital afterlife is a complex tale with a depth of lore that stems from Master Reboot. While this was applauded by many, we listened to your feedback and realised how the story unravelled was sometimes quite... muddy. We have reassessed and adjusted the order of the memory clips so that you receive both the corrupted AND the restored memories at the same time, which makes it a little easier to piece together the unfolding events.

[h2]Reduced Ending Requirements[/h2]
We have reduced the requirements to reach the ending so you can complete the game in less time, but achievement and lore hunters will still be able to play the extra content. Soul Axiom Rebooted is no longer a 100% puzzle completion game – meaning if you’re stuck on a few but still want to unlock one of the three endings, you can.

[h2]Permanent Price Drop Plus FREE DLC[/h2]
To celebrate the Rebooted edition of Soul Axiom, we’re permanently reducing the base price of the game to £9.99 / €9,99 / $12.99. Additionally, we are giving away the Artbook & Soundtrack DLC for free with every purchase. The artbook can be viewed in-game as well as via the files in the DLC download. 

[h2]QoL Improvements[/h2]
- Added restart & return to hub options in the pause menu
- Fullscreen exclusive added
- Allow the use of powers whilst sprinting
- Increased the speed of powers by 80%
- Added option to skip cutscenes
- Improved controller interactions
- Default to toggle crouch

[h2]General Improvements[/h2]
- Major optimisations throughout the game
- Improved gameplay in several levels
- Various bug fixes throughout the game

[h2]Visual Improvements[/h2]
- Replace many static lights with dynamic lights 
- Added screen-space reflections
- Increased lightmaps
- Improved some colour grading and post-processing effects

[h2]Soul Axiom: Legacy Version[/h2]
The original game will be removed from the Steam store. You will soon not be able to buy the game. However, if you already own Soul Axiom, the game [u]will still be in your library[/u] and [u]you will still be able to play that version[/u] if you wish. Game collectors rejoice ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Soul Axiom Rebooted: the new enhanced version for Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715316/d27b7a31e6d5563c639e6ef6fccd8e7be8163d3e.gif[/img]

Wales Interactive are proud to reveal [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206620/Soul_Axiom_Rebooted/]Soul Axiom Rebooted[/url][/b], the new enhanced version of the 2016 first-person puzzle game Soul Axiom. Coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch on 27th February 2020.

Soul Axiom was entirely rebuilt with an engine upgrade with the purpose of releasing it on Nintendo Switch for the very first time. It brought a whole bunch of additions, improvements, optimisation and fixes, so we're proud to be offering both Steam and Switch users the best version of the game! 

[previewyoutube=c4f5VtTBZIg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
For a preview of what's changed, see our notes below. For an in-depth view of the changes, and to find out what happens to the original Soul Axiom game on Steam, see our follow-up post coming very soon [[b]tip[/b]: add the game to your Wishlist or subscribe to the forum to be notified].

[h2]About the game[/h2]
Soul Axiom Rebooted is a first-person story-driven adventure puzzle game, set in the beautiful, haunting cyber-world of Elysia. The original game was released on Steam, Wii U, Xbox One and PS4 and was nominated for several awards, including Best Game at BAFTA Cymru Awards, Use of Narrative at Develop Awards and Best Console/PC Hardcore at Game Connection America.

[h2]Rebooted notes[/h2]
+ Localisation support
+ A new objective marker system
+ Major optimisations throughout
+ Improved checkpoint & save system
+ Reduced completion requirements
+ Enhanced dynamic lighting
+ Many QoL improvements
+ A reduced base price
+ Free artbook & soundtrack DLC (Steam)

Don't forget, the in-depth look at these changes are coming very soon! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1206620/discussions/]Subscribe[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206620/Soul_Axiom_Rebooted/]Wishlist[/url] on Steam to stay up to date. 

Wales Interactive
